items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel Sr. is out for the remainder of the game due to a hamstring injury. Rapoport: already ruled out.
items.why: In-game hamstring; Schefter/Rap confirmation. ETR watching.
items.implication: Zero remaining production; check severity for ROS. Boost to other SF WRs/TE.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to remaining SF pass-catchers (e.g. Kittle active).

items.text: Cardinals trading Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans (MHJ + 2027 7th for 2027 2nd + 6th). Fresh start; Texans WR room now includes Nico Collins, Boutte, Dell, Hutchinson, MHJ. Inactive context for ARI prior.
items.why: Rapoport + Schefter blockbuster report; ETR had not expected for ARI. Bio change noted.
items.implication: Immediate HOU help + long-term; ARI WR vacuum (Wilson etc.). Sit if owned in short term pending debut.
items.opportunity: Targets shift in both offenses; HOU depth chart upgrade, ARI role expansion for remaining WRs.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with a groin injury.
items.why: Schefter mid-day downgrade; ETR watching list. Rap earlier Q.
items.implication: Sit; HOU RB committee shifts to remaining backs.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for other HOU RBs (e.g. any handcuff/backup).

items.text: Terry McLaurin will play / active after hamstring; not full go but cleared.
items.why: ETR FINAL; Commanders inactives confirm active, Diggs out.
items.implication: Startable WR2/3 with possible snap limit; Diggs absence helps.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets with Diggs inactive.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty is a go after hopeful GTD status on plantar fasciitis/ankle; worked out pregame.
items.why: Rapoport: is a go. ETR FINAL UPDATE confirms will play. Elevated RB as contingency unused.
items.implication: Start as RB1/2; monitor for limited early workload.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/routes if full go; handcuff elevated previously.

items.text: Justin Jefferson will be active today; Jordan Addison won’t be. Odell Beckham Jr also down.
items.why: Rapoport official active/inactive call; Jefferson wanted to play home in LA area.
items.implication: Start Jefferson; Addison sit. Jefferson may see boosted targets.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets without Addison; managed snaps possible on ankle.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase will play in Week 5 after earlier uncertainty around concussion protocol.
items.why: ETR final morning updates confirmed will play; aligned with practice progression.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; full or near-full snaps expected.
items.opportunity: High target share in CIN offense vs MIA.

items.text: Tee Higgins will play after adductor/neck issues; confirmed in ETR updates.
items.why: Returned to full practice Friday; ETR and reports clear him.
items.opportunity: Secondary target volume in two-WR sets.

items.text: Jordan Addison not expected to play / inactive; Jefferson expected/active.
items.why: ETR update and Rapoport confirmation on hamstring.
items.implication: Sit Addison; boost to Jefferson and other MIN pass-catchers.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: David Montgomery (groin, later OUT), Quinshon Judkins (foot), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), Deebo Samuel (hamstring, later OUT), TJ Hockenson (concussion, later OUT), others.
items.why: ETR live post-game/injury monitor list; several confirmed OUT mid/late.
items.implication: Monitor for ROS; immediate sits for OUT players.

items.text: Zay Flowers officially active tonight (Ravens inactives).
items.why: Schefter on Ravens inactives; ETR expected to play.
items.implication: Start as WR2/3; full role expected.

items.text: Jaylen Warren passes every test (advanced stats, eye test); Ekeler-esque. Coaching staffs refused workhorse including this one splitting with Dowdle pre-injury. Insane with Dowdle out.
items.why: Levitan player-specific: volume unlocked, efficiency elite while Dowdle sidelined.
items.implication: Must-start RB2/flex with 20+ touch upside; lock in lineups.
items.opportunity: Workhorse snaps, carries, targets, third-down; no split.

items.text: George Kittle officially active (illness earlier, expected to play).
items.implication: Start TE1; even more valuable with Deebo later out.

items.text: Ladd McConkey is active but not expected to play meaningful snaps.
items.why: Schefter report; ETR had as not expected. Foot issue.
items.implication: Avoid in lineups; low snap share likely. Beneficiaries in LAC WR room.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston or others may see more routes if limited.

items.text: Vikings TE T.J. Hockenson (concussion) downgraded to out.
items.implication: Sit TE; MIN TE vacuum possible for others.

items.text: Caleb Williams is officially inactive but has a chance to play next week (hamstring).
items.why: Rapoport confirmation; ETR listed not expected.
items.implication: Sit; backup QB implications for CHI pass-catchers volume.
items.opportunity: Potential short-term boost or change for Rome Odunze, DJ Moore, etc.

items.text: Rico Dowdle not expected to play / inactive (toe); continues multi-week absence.
items.why: ETR weekend summary; confirmed inactive in reports.
items.implication: Sit; full workhorse to Jaylen Warren.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.why: Berry notes heat on waivers amid GB RB situation.
items.opportunity: Potential expanded role if GB injuries/usage shifts.
